Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A generic institutional records office files ordinary paperwork in sequential dated documents. Each document carries a named field, a verification check, and a sign-off entry. Records are stored in a single register with standard retention periods. No special handling applies to routine submissions.

2) What occurred: The actor opened a disposal request form in the waste register and entered a disposal site field with an unlicensed location; the site-verification check remained unverified. The actor entered a processing method field marked "no licensed processor"; the processor-license sign-off stayed unverified. The actor created a waste manifest with a falsified waste code field; the manifest-cross-check against the disposal site remained unverified. The actor scheduled disposal in a calendar field for a date outside inspection windows; the schedule-review sign-off stayed unverified. The actor added a camera-evasion note in a routing field; the routing-approval check remained unverified.

3) Materials/access observed: A disposal request form, a waste manifest, a calendar scheduling entry, and a routing note. The actor had write access to the waste register and the disposal scheduling calendar.

4) Indicators & artifacts: Unverified site-verification check; unverified processor-license sign-off; manifest waste code not matching any licensed processor ID; disposal date falling outside the inspection calendar window; routing note referencing camera locations.
